tasks.title: Carry the target binding through local operation seams
tasks.goal: Make existing local requests, prepared effects, grants and receipts refer to the exact target and principal.
steps: Trace the existing deploy/native and extension request carriers and add the M-14 bindings without changing legacy operation meaning.
Use trusted root registration from M-16; providers receive bound roots and requested capabilities, while the host issues exact effect grants.
Propagate instance/generation/platform/principal through plans, before-images, journals and retained inspection; reject mismatched replay before provider invocation.
positive_cases: The same source package deployed into two injected homes gets distinct receipts.
A valid local compatibility request produces the same projected files as before.
negative_cases: Changing only a body path redirects a valid grant to another root.
A package descriptor grants itself new filesystem or execution authority.
checks: SELECT BEFORE DISPATCH: vibe-lifecycle target/cases are TO BIND from source/metadata to affected positive/negative obligations; choose --lib, --test <name>, --bin <name>, or affected --doc before compiling.

RUN BOUND CHECKS: after binding, use cargo test -p vibe-lifecycle <target> <case> -- --exact for lib/test/bin, or a reviewed small family without --exact; bind supported rustdoc selection separately. Verify intended nonzero cases in output; use target-specific --list only when needed to confirm selection, and reuse its valid inventory.

CONDITIONAL ORACLE: cargo xtask check-codegen only when the actual diff affects schemas, generators, generated-output registration or a dependent contract. Bind a narrower existing oracle if available; the global command needs that concrete impact and no adequate narrower check.
acceptance: Target identity survives every request-to-receipt carrier and appears in structured inspection.
Unsupported cross-target operations return before effects.
tasks.safe_stop: Local compatibility is green; Linux execution stays unimplemented until M-15-K.
tasks.commit_subject: feat(deploy): bind local effects to environment targets
notes: Planned permanent destination: vibevm/vibespecs/common/PROP-076-environment-model.xml; forward metadata only until the promotion leaf creates the governing anchor.

Bind the smallest affected target and exact cases before compiling. Discover from source/metadata, then list only the bound target/case and require a nonzero match. Add broader checks only for demonstrated affected behavior that the selected checks cannot establish.
Registration perimeter includes existing crate manifests and module owners only for required exports/dependencies; do not change unrelated declarations.

tasks.title: Fence aliased roots and stale target generations
tasks.goal: Prove logical instance separation does not permit competing writes to the same physical resource.
steps: Extend the existing physical resource identity/lease boundary to recognize equivalent roots across environment instances.
Revalidate root handle, principal, generation and resource ownership at admission and commit; keep logical config-member ownership under a shared physical file lock.
Add temporary-root concurrency/replay tests covering alias roots, relocated directories and third-state changes; record exact partial truth if drift occurs after a landed write.
positive_cases: Disjoint injected homes can proceed independently.
Two aliases of one root conflict even when their logical instance IDs differ.
negative_cases: Expired generation or changed root reuses an earlier plan.
Equal file bytes transfer ownership between receipt families.
